points.quote: The use of Generative Artificial Intelligence that does not comply with assignment instructions;
points.anchor: 5.6.14 Unauthorised use of Generative Artificial Intelligence
points.gist: Using generative AI in a way that does not comply with assignment instructions counts as unauthorised use and may be academic misconduct.

points.quote: The use of Generative Artificial Intelligence to generate text, materials or other outputs presented by the student as the student’s own work.
points.anchor: 5.6.14 Unauthorised use of Generative Artificial Intelligence
points.gist: Using generative AI to generate text, materials or other outputs that the student presents as their own work may be unauthorised use.

points.quote: Submitting work as one’s own for assessment, which has, in fact, been done in whole or in part by someone else or submitting work which has been created artificially, e.g., by a machine or through artificial intelligence.
points.gist: Submitting work as your own that was done by someone else, or created by a machine or artificial intelligence, is listed as academic misconduct.

points.quote: A declaration of academic integrity will be completed for all assignments and examinations by students.
points.gist: Students complete a declaration of academic integrity for all assignments and examinations.

points.quote: Academic misconduct can be either intentional or inadvertent.
points.gist: Academic misconduct can be intentional or inadvertent.

points.quote: The level of proof is “on the balance of probabilities” (i.e., whether it is more likely than not that the action or event occurred).
points.gist: The level of proof for misconduct is on the balance of probabilities, meaning more likely than not that it occurred.

points.quote: When students have been found to have engaged in academic misconduct, as part of the process outlined in this policy their name is entered on the Academic Misconduct Register.
points.gist: Students found to have engaged in academic misconduct have their name entered on the Academic Misconduct Register.

points.quote: If the student is already on the Academic Misconduct Register or if the alleged misconduct is deemed to be a Level 2 or a Level 3 violation, the case will be referred to the University Academic Misconduct Board (UAMB)
points.anchor: 5.11 Outline of the Academic Misconduct Procedure
points.gist: Students already on the register, or alleged Level 2 or Level 3 violations, are referred to the University Academic Misconduct Board.

points.quote: The determination of the penalties will take into account the gravity of the academic misconduct, the scale of the unfair advantage potentially gained, and the degree to which the act of misconduct was premeditated and deliberate.
points.gist: Penalties take into account the gravity of the misconduct, the unfair advantage potentially gained, and how premeditated and deliberate it was.

points.quote: The student may bring a student colleague of their choice or a sabbatical officer of the Students’ Union to any meeting held under this policy and associated procedure.
points.anchor: 5.11 Outline of the Academic Misconduct Procedure
points.gist: A student may bring a student colleague or a Students' Union sabbatical officer to any meeting held under the policy.

points.quote: An appeal of any decision under this policy may only be made on the following grounds:
points.gist: Appeals may only be made on the listed grounds, which are new evidence and material procedural error.

points.quote: Communication is normally via MTU email, and it is the responsibility of both staff and students to monitor their emails regularly during term time.
points.gist: Communication is normally via MTU email, and staff and students are responsible for monitoring their emails regularly during term time.

points.quote: Staff will be able to refer suspected cases of academic misconduct to a specialist function which can analyse files and other digital content, and, as appropriate, internet and software usage
points.gist: Staff can refer suspected misconduct to a specialist function that can analyse files, digital content and, as appropriate, internet and software usage.

points.quote: Sharing or selling staff or institutional intellectual property (IP) with third parties without permission;
points.gist: Sharing or selling staff or institutional intellectual property with third parties without permission is listed as misconduct.

points.quote: A breach of some of the provisions of this policy by a student may render them subject to disciplinary action under the Student Disciplinary Procedure.
points.gist: A student's breach of some provisions may lead to disciplinary action under the Student Disciplinary Procedure.
